peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 2.2% below its local comparables; 23 of 44 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (58.8): 5.1 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 29 of 51 similar developments (the same as 2). Context, not scored: resales in 58.3% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $1,159,000 ($1,914 psf, 592–613 sq ft; 8 resales, Aug 2024–Jul 2026); 4 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,949 psf (range $1,790–2,245); 1.8% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $21,000 less. 2-bedroom: median $1,800,000 ($1,911 psf, 904–957 sq ft; 8 resales, Jul 2024–Jun 2026); 5 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,962 psf (range $1,912–2,313); 2.6% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $48,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Lavender MRT about 170 m, Nicoll Highway MRT about 690 m; closer than 37 of 51 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 3 within 2 km; nearest Farrer Park Primary School about 1,650 m; more than 0 of 51 similar developments (the same as 8). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 5 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 340 m), more than 21 of 51 similar developments (the same as 6); nearest hawker centre North Bridge Road Market about 90 m; nearest park Kallang Riverside Park about 100 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 7 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Aurea, 39 new sales, about 400 m; Midtown Modern, 1 new sales, about 1,180 m; Midtown Bay, 4 new sales, about 1,350 m; Piccadilly Grand, 1 new sales, about 1,430 m; Duet @ Emily, 3 new sales, about 1,670 m; The Collective at One Sophia, 16 new sales, about 1,770 m; The Arcady at Boon Keng, 32 new sales, about 1,890 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 146 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 96 new sales and 534 resales (630 purchases); new sales were 15.2% of these purchases. Subsales (39) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Kallang Close GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 800 m; Dorset Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,560 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 534 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 15 of 51 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 534 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 563 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−5.2%). Planning-area private resales −11.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
